Application Data.NAME: Stitch & Style Tailoring Co.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Stitch & Style Tailoring Co. is a professional tailoring and dressmaking business that offers high-quality custom clothing and alterations. We specialize in creating tailored suits, dresses, and formal wear, ensuring a perfect fit for our clients. Our operations emphasize quality craftsmanship, attention to detail, and exceptional customer service. We have a dedicated team of skilled tailors who are trained in the latest techniques and trends in fashion. Our shop maintains rigorous quality control procedures and effective inventory management to handle fabrics and garments securely. We prioritize the safety of our premises with fire prevention measures and secure storage for customer garments, minimizing risks associated with operations.
Application Data.GENERAL INFO QUESTIONS:

2. **No** - The business does not sponsor any athletic teams.

6. **No** - The business does not lease employees to or from other employers.

7. **Yes** - Workers Compensation is carried for all employees.

8. **No** - The applicant does not own or operate any other business.

9. **No** - There is no other insurance with this company.

10. **No** - The business is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products.

11. **No** - The business does not rent or loan equipment to others.

12. **No** - The applicant has not had a foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years.

14. **No** - The business does not have additional catastrophe exposure beyond typical operational risks.

15. **No** - There have been no past losses or claims related to sexual abuse, molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring.

16. **No** - There are no uncorrected fire code violations.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/15/2022, a power failure occurred due to a storm, resulting in $2,500 in damages from spoiled fabrics and lost work hours. The claim is in progress and pending review.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B Safe, Standard Grade, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Secured fencing with surveillance cameras and nightly watchpersons.

Tailors & Dressmakers
Underwriting Appetite
• Preferred:
– Businesses with fewer than 10 employees, operating for more than 3 years, demonstrating
a consistent history of clean claims and effective risk management practices.
– Established client base with documented quality control procedures and clear inventory
management.
– Physical premises with appropriate fire safety measures, secure storage for customer
garments, and limited exposure to flammable materials.
• Acceptable:
– Businesses with 10 to 20 employees, with moderate safety and security measures in place.
– Operations between 1 and 3 years, provided there is no significant claims history or
underwriting red flags.
